_comment: Complex Nutrition digestion rules (since v0.2.2), used while tracking runs. Fullness: the stomach holds the world's Max fullness setting (since v0.3.5; default 300, 0 for no limit; a new character starts empty), which is vanilla satiety's maximum while tracking runs; vanilla's own is vanillaFullnessMax. Each food fills fullnessPerGram per gram of its weight; meals, pies and anything whose code contains one of cookedWords fill cookedFullness times that; liquids fill liquidFullness times that. In a pot meal (since v0.4.1), an ingredient matching a cookedGrainFullness pattern counts at that many times its dry weight, because grains and dry beans soak up water as they cook. Fullness drains fullnessDrainPerHour per in-game hour. Satiety from other mods' code for food without data fills unknownFullnessPerSatiety per point. Gut pools: eating adds grams of net carbohydrate (carbohydrate minus fibre), protein and fats; a pool holds at most maxGrams and the rest passes through unused. Since v0.2.4 a pool absorbs maxRateGrams * g / (halfRateGrams + g) grams per in-game hour while it holds g grams: little when nearly empty, levelling off at maxRateGrams when full. Absorbed grams give kcalPerGram calories; above diminishingAboveGrams absorbed within windowHours, an extra x grams count as diminishingScaleGrams * ln(1 + x / diminishingScaleGrams); with taperEndGrams set (protein, since v0.3.0), the yield per gram instead falls in a straight line from full at diminishingAboveGrams to taperEndValue at taperEndGrams, and every gram past that yields beyondValue. Protein absorbed over 24 hours is measured against the protein pool's diminishingAboveGrams (the least the body needs; nutrients.json's protein dailyTarget should match) and its bar runs up to taperEndGrams. Activity burns calories at kcalPerSatiety per point of vanilla satiety it would have burned, times activityBurnMultiplier (0.95 since v0.3.6j, a 5% cut; healing is not affected), and switching tracking off turns the calorie reserve back into satiety at the same rate. With a fibre reserve at fiberBonusFullAt % of a day's need or more, a pool's rate is fiberSpeedBonus faster (less in step with a lower reserve). Eaten fibre also goes into the gut (since v0.3.5), up to fiberGutMaxGrams, where it is absorbed at the fibre reserve's own steady rate (nutrients.json drainPerDay of its dailyTarget a day) and gives fiberKcalPerGram calories a gram, with no diminishing returns. An empty calorie reserve deals starvationDamage every starvationSeconds. (After death the reserve is set by the world's Respawn calories setting, since v0.3.2.) The HUD calorie bar flashes below flashBelow of a full reserve.
